items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. Yeah. Edgar Hayes. But we went on with Jimmy Lunceford, with Harold Oxley.

ctx.x: : You're not talking about Harold Baker, are you?
No, I don't think Harold was in that band. They were all older musicians, much older.
: Oh, there was a good trumpet player that went with Teddy Wilson later.
